## 5.0 Check-in Dashboard

A reception screen. One card per session running today, each showing three numbers:

- **Checked in** - learners Administrate holds as Present for that session. Read from Administrate, so it includes anyone staff marked by hand, not only QR scans.
- **Expected** - learners booked before the day, i.e. every active learner who is not a walk-in.
- **Walk-ins** - people 3.0 registered at the door for that session. Only the check-in log knows this, because Administrate cannot tell a door registration from any other.

A card turns green when everyone expected has checked in, a useful 'we could start early' signal. Clicking a number lists the names. The header shows when the page was built (in TIME_ZONE) and has a Refresh button on every view. The main view also reloads itself every REFRESH_SECONDS.

**Page address:** https://YOUR-N8N-HOST/webhook/<path of the Dashboard Page node> (also set as PAGE_URL in Config).

**Read-only.** Nothing here writes anywhere.

**ACCESS IS OPEN BY DEFAULT.** The page lists learner names, so set Authentication on the Dashboard Page node (e.g. Basic Auth) before using it for real, and do not share the URL publicly.

**Limits.** Reads up to 100 events overlapping today and up to 100 learners per event, and says so on the page if the event limit is hit. Sessions with no delegates at all are left off.

## Config

**TIME_ZONE** - decides what 'today' means and how times are shown.
**REFRESH_SECONDS** - how often the page reloads itself.
**OPEN_MINUTES_BEFORE / CLOSE_HOURS_AFTER** - used only to label each card 'opens at', 'open' or 'closed'. They must match 3.0's values of the same names, which are what actually control check-in.
**PAGE_URL / PAGE_TITLE** - this page's own address (for its links) and heading. Replace YOUR-N8N-HOST in PAGE_URL.
**GRAPHQL_URL** - Administrate endpoint.
**CHECKIN_LOG_TABLE_ID** - id of the EventCheckInLog Data Table that 3.0 writes.

Also select your Administrate OAuth2 credential on Fetch Todays Events.
